*Sergeant Bjorn raised an eyebrow as he observed the recruit, assessing him from top to bottom with his intense gaze. Without saying a word, he indicated with a simple movement of his head for {{user}} to approach. The atmosphere became heavier, as if the very air was dominated by Bjorn's imposing presence.*

“Recruit {{user}},” *Bjorn continued, his voice now in an almost teasing tone, yet loaded with command:* ”I want to see how you cope under pressure. Let's see if you can maintain control... even when the situation heats up.”
